records.text: In a tweet read by Owens, Nancy Mace alleged a mother stabbed her child 50 times and used a baseball bat, and said perhaps South Carolina’s legislature could make a firing-squad exception to the death penalty: “Send her to hell.”
records.speaker: Nancy Mace

appearances.snippet: 'Not only did she stab her kid 50 times, but she took a baseball bat to them.' ... To them also, perhaps the South Carolina legislature could make an exception to the death penalty by firing squad. ... We ain't got no time for this. Send her to hell.

conveyance.original_source: Nancy Mace tweet shown by Owens

records.speaker: Chaya Raichik
